verdict.rationale: Fellow documents recording in-person meetings, but only by capturing audio from the desktop. Transcripts are searchable, and the pricing page lists audio and video uploads. Nothing in the evidence mentions a mobile app for recording or transcribing conversations, so the story's core mobile-capture requirement is unevidenced and desktop capture is only an adjacent feature.

support.subject: As a founder, I can record and transcribe in-person conversations from a mobile app, and those notes land in the same searchable workspace
